name: Hunan Yujing Machinery Co.,Ltd
summary: Hunan Yujing Machinery Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, design, production, and sale of CNC equipment for cutting, grinding, and polishing in China and internationally. The company provides multi wire saw, single-side and double-side lapping polishing, and CNC polishing machines; and diamond wire and carbon/carbon composites, as well as precision forming CNC, and other hard and fragile material processing machines. Its products are mainly used for precision processing of hard and fragile materials, such as cover glass of mobile phone, solar photovoltaic silicon wafer, magnetic material, sapphire, silicon carbide, window glass, LED semiconductor lighting, piezoelectric crystal…
